contracts.name: Health-tech admission
contracts.historical_guarantee: Admitted work has a documented healthcare purpose and a technology, informatics or health-AI contribution.

contracts.name: Regional role admission
contracts.historical_guarantee: An admitted regional work claim requires an affirmative regional creator-role decision.

contracts.name: Temporal attribution
contracts.historical_guarantee: Dated attribution uses half-open intervals; an expired or unknown-current assertion cannot establish current presence.

contracts.name: Publication authority
contracts.historical_guarantee: Model output alone cannot authorize a public work claim.

contracts.name: Independent source channels
contracts.historical_guarantee: Each admitted source class can qualify independently of source platform.

contracts.name: No repository prerequisite
contracts.historical_guarantee: A valid publication, preprint or discussion does not require a repository or project grouping.

contracts.name: No name-only identity merge
contracts.historical_guarantee: A matching name is insufficient for an identity merge.

contracts.name: Typed identities
contracts.historical_guarantee: Person, account and organization identities cannot be silently merged across kinds.

contracts.name: Replay idempotence
contracts.historical_guarantee: Replaying the same stable source identity does not create another identity in the retained set.

contracts.name: Evidence retention
contracts.historical_guarantee: A failed refresh preserves retained evidence and cannot establish a new healthy observation.

contracts.name: Evidence-head guard
contracts.historical_guarantee: A current public projection cannot commit against a different retained evidence head.

contracts.name: Supported relation endpoints
contracts.historical_guarantee: A public relation requires an admitted relation and available admitted endpoints.

contracts.name: Reuse claims
contracts.historical_guarantee: Unknown or restricted license evidence cannot create an unrestricted-reuse claim.

contracts.name: Public field projection
contracts.historical_guarantee: Public display is restricted to admitted public fields; internal candidate fields stay outside the projection.

contracts.name: Query admission
contracts.historical_guarantee: Every query result belongs to the admitted snapshot and satisfies the selected filters.

contracts.name: Filter algebra
contracts.historical_guarantee: OR within a selected facet and AND across facets are deterministic, commutative and idempotent.

contracts.name: Strict total ordering
contracts.historical_guarantee: The declared sort key gives a strict total order when stable tie identities are distinct.

contracts.name: Sort transitivity
contracts.historical_guarantee: The lexicographic comparator is transitive for all declared integer key coordinates.

contracts.name: Date integrity
contracts.historical_guarantee: Changing ingestion time alone cannot improve a source-event-date sort key. Unknown dates remain explicit.

contracts.name: Cursor binding
contracts.historical_guarantee: A continuation is rejected when its snapshot, normalized query or sort mode changes.

contracts.name: Pagination partition
contracts.historical_guarantee: Positive-size keyset pages partition a fixed finite ordered snapshot without duplicates or omissions.

contracts.name: Request budget
contracts.historical_guarantee: A guarded atomic request counter cannot exceed its declared run budget.

contracts.name: Byte budget
contracts.historical_guarantee: A guarded append cannot retain more than its declared byte budget.

contracts.name: Conditional round-robin fairness
contracts.historical_guarantee: Every member of a fixed nonempty eligible source cohort has a slot in one complete round.

contracts.name: Nonvacuous coverage
contracts.historical_guarantee: An empty enrollment or an incomplete, failed or truncated check set cannot claim completed enrolled-scope coverage.

contracts.name: Cohort accounting
contracts.historical_guarantee: Within one retained cohort, published membership is contained in admitted membership and captured membership.

contracts.name: Project grouping
contracts.historical_guarantee: A project relationship needs admitted relationship evidence; shared titles alone cannot establish grouping.

contracts.name: Policy-head guard
contracts.historical_guarantee: A changed geography, relevance or review-policy head invalidates current-projection status until readmission.

contracts.name: Lifecycle safety
contracts.historical_guarantee: All states reachable under the declared abstract transitions preserve admission and retained-evidence invariants.

contracts.name: Operational paths
contracts.historical_guarantee: The explicit finite workflows retain typed declarations, consistent obligations and supported completion paths, including holds.

contracts.name: Exact nine-county policy
contracts.historical_guarantee: The admitted county relation is exactly the selected nine-county set; unknown or outside keys cannot satisfy membership.

contracts.name: Corroboration deduplication
contracts.historical_guarantee: Repeating evidence from the same admitted provenance origin cannot increase the distinct-origin set.
